traits.name: Resistance
traits.desc: You have Resistance to Poison damage.

traits.name: Legacy Cantrip
traits.desc: You know the Poison Spray cantrip (Charisma).

traits.name: Level 1 Spell
traits.desc: Starting at level 3, you always have Ray of Sickness prepared; you can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot (or with a slot).

traits.name: Level 2 Spell
traits.desc: Starting at level 5, you always have Hold Person prepared; you can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot (or with a slot).
